answer: Serial-time cost: joining requires a chained puzzle where each step seeds the next, so one identity costs 40 minutes of sequential compute folded into the consensus beacon — a jetty no shortcut can bypass, since parallel hardware cannot speed a chain waiting on its own output. A 200-agent farm needs 133 serial hours even on 100 GPUs. Clones are caught when two identities' beacon timestamps land within 90 seconds: the network flags them as one island of fakes and slashes 100% of each 1,000 POA bond. Each seed is single-use, like a comet that passes once.
